storyline.real: Senna, far ahead of Prost, crashes at Portier on lap 67; Prost wins
storyline.headline: Senna keeps his concentration and wins in Monte Carlo

mastery.label: Bring it home: no laps at PUSH

eras.briefing: Monaco, May 1988. Senna started on pole in the McLaren-Honda and leads; Prost spent the first half of the race stuck behind Berger's Ferrari. Turbo fuel is down to 150 litres this year. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports.

storylineRetirements.real: Prost passed Berger for second on lap 54 and started trading fastest laps with Senna, who answered (his fastest lap on lap 59); on lap 67, as McLaren radioed him to slow down, Senna lost concentration at Portier and crashed out of the lead
